name: District police portals of Barishal Range (Jhalokathi, Patuakhali, Pirojpur, Bhola, Barguna)
organization: Bangladesh Police — district police units of Barishal Range
attribution: District and thana police portals (police.<district>.gov.bd, police.<upazila>.<district>.gov.bd)
notes: No licence stated. SP offices from the Superintendent's officer card; thanas from each upazila's thana portal officer cards (office landline, OC's police official mobile, *.gov.bd e-mail). Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. Barishal Range (Range DIG's office, policedig.barisaldiv.gov.bd) covers the 6 districts of the division; Barishal District is in BARISHAL_POLICE_2026 and Barishal city's BMP thanas in BARISHAL_METRO_POLICE_THANAS_2026. Jhalokathi's police portals are under jhalakathi.gov.bd. Thanas that are not upazilas have no portal here.
